newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia Yield Spreads-Mixed vs the bloc.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia Yield Spreads-Mixed vs the bloc.

text.p: Australian bond yield spreads were fairly mixed against fellow dollar bloc partners with the local market pausing for breath after the wild gyrations of recent days, traders said.
Spreads to the U.S. reversed an early tightening as the market attracted some profit-taking after defying further weakness in U.S. Treasuries on Thursday amid solid offshore investor demand.
However, the performance of the U.S. market in the wake of Fed Chairman Alan Greenspan's warning of a pre-emptive policy tightening will continue to keep local bonds on their guard.
